area.score.yours.text: A Zone consists of at least two identical numbers. One of your Zones earns you {scoring} points.
area.score.theirs.text: A Zone consists of at least two identical numbers. One of {player}'s Zones earns them {scoring} points.
cross.help.yours.remaining: You must play this Operation {crossesRemaining, plural, one{# more time} other{# more times}} during the game.
cross.help.theirs.remaining: {opponentName} must play this Operation {crossesRemaining, plural, one{# more time} other{# more times}} during the game.
danger.tick.help.text: Each Cross indicates a 5-point penalty for crossing a River without a Canoe, for entering a number greater than 12, or for each circle not belonging to a Trail or Zone at the end of the game.
danger.tick.help.yours.score: You currently have {tickNumber, plural, one{# 5-point penalty} other{# 5-point penalties}}.
danger.tick.help.theirs.score: {player} currently has {tickNumber, plural, one{# 5-point penalty} other{# 5-point penalties}}.
exploration.node.spider.text: Spiders have infested this circle, either because a number greater than 12 has been entered, or because this circle did not belong to a Trail or a Zone at the end of the game. These Spiders represent a 5-point penalty.
exploration.node.number.yours: This circle is already filled in. You cannot enter any more numbers in it.
exploration.node.number.theirs: This circle is already filled in. {player} cannot enter any more numbers in it.
number.card.help.text: You can score Observation points thanks to this card whenever you enter the number {cardNumber} in your Jungle.
observation.card.revelead.help.text: Advance on the Score Track for this Observation, by entering the number {number} (of the corresponding numbered card). This Observation currently gives you {pointsEarned, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
observation.number.help.text: Enter a {targetNumber} in your Jungle to increase your score on the attached Observation.
observation.scores.help.text: Progress along the Observation track to score points. Reaching this level of Observation will give you {targetNumber} points.
observation.scores.help.text.other: Progress along the Observation track to score points. Reaching this level of Observation will give {player} {targetNumber} points.
pathway.score.yours.text:
A Trail is a sequence of at least 2 numbers exactly following each other. 

One of your Trails is currently worth {scoring} points.
pathway.score.theirs.text:
A Trail is a sequence of at least 2 numbers exactly following each other. 

One of {player}'s Trails is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} to them.
piranha.help.yours.text:
You get a penalty for crossing this River, because you entered a number that did not give you a Canoe. 

5 points will be taken off your total score for this penalty.
piranha.help.theirs.text:
{player} gets a penalty for crossing this River, because {player} entered a number that did not give them a Canoe. 

5 points will be taken off {player}'s total score for this penalty.
score.ring.yours.scoring:
This marker indicates your progress in Observing an animal species. 

This Observation is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
score.ring.theirs.scoring:
This marker indicates {player}'s progress in Observing an animal species. 

This Observation is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}} to {player}.
sub.total.observations.yours.text: The sum of your Observations is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.pathways.yours.text: The sum of your Trails is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.areas.yours.text: The sum of your Zones is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.dangers.yours.text: The sum of your Danger penalties means you are losing {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.observations.theirs.text: The sum of {player}'s Observations is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.pathways.theirs.text: The sum of {player}'s Trails is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.areas.theirs.text: The sum of {player}'s Zones is currently worth {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
sub.total.dangers.theirs.text: The sum of {player}'s Danger penalties means they are losing {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
total.help.yours.text: Your total score is {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
total.help.theirs.text: {player}'s total score is {scoring, plural, one{# point} other{# points}}.
area.node.help.title: Jungle circle
area.node.yours.help.text: A circle in which you can enter a number, provided that it is next to a circle that has already been filled in.
area.node.theirs.help.text: A circle in which {player} can enter a number, provided that it is next to a circle that has already been filled in.
area.score.help.title: Zone Score
cross.help.title: Operation marker
cross.help.text: You must use each Operation four times. This marker indicates that you have used an Operation from this line.
danger.tick.help.title: Danger Marker
exploration.node.number.help.title: Filled in circle
exploration.map.help.title: Playing Area
exploration.map.yours.help.text: Your playing area, made up of adjacent circles.
exploration.map.theirs.help.text: {player}'s playing area, made up of adjacent circles.
exploration.map.connexity.help.text: To score points, you must fill in the forest circles to form Zones with identical numbers, or Trails with numbers that follow one another exactly.
exploration.map.river.help.text: Some circles are Rivers: entering a number using an Operation that does not give a Canoe symbol will mean a 5-point penalty.
exploration.map.scoring.help.text: The sum of your Observations, Zones, Trails and Danger penalties makes up your final score!
green.dice.help.title: The Green Die
green.dice.help.text: The Green Die is rolled at the start of each round, and the number shown can be used in an Operation. It contains all the numbers from 1 to 6.
number.card.help.title: Numbered card
observation.card.help.title: Observation card
observation.card.hidden.help.text: This Observation card is hidden for now. Enter the number {number} to reveal it.
observation.number.help.title: Observation number
observation.scores.help.title: Observation Score
path.help.title: Trail
path.text: A Trail links two adjacent numbers that follow each other exactly. A Trail scores as many points as the highest number, plus the number of other circles making up that Trail.
pathway.score.help.title: Trail Score
piranha.help.title: Danger: Piranha
score.ring.help.title: Observation Score
score.ring.text: The circle indicates what the player scored by Observing.
sub.total.help.title: Sub-total Score
total.help.title: Total Score
yellow.dice.help.title: The Yellow Die
yellow.dice.help.text: The Yellow Die is rolled at the start of each round, and the number shown can be used in an Operation. It contains all the numbers from 0 to 5.
header.you.choose.node: Select an empty circle to write a {result} in it.
header.opponent.choose: Opponents still have to play a number
header.discover.obs: Rare species have been revealed for the first time!
header.end.game: The game is over! The Spiders are invading the orphan circles...
spider.help.title: End of game Spiders
spider.help.text: At the end of the game, this circle did not belong to either a Zone or a Trail. As a result, it was immediately infested by Spiders, and the player gets a 5-point penalty.
area.node.help.play.text: This circle is next to a circle that has already been filled in, or this is your first turn. You can enter a number here.
area.node.help.play.button: Enter the number in this circle
area.node.river.help.yours.text:
This circle is a River circle. 

You should instead enter a number from an Operation with the Canoe symbol. Otherwise, you will incur a penalty.
area.node.river.help.theirs.text:
This circle is a River circle. 

{player} should instead enter a number from an Operation with the Canoe symbol. Otherwise, they will incur a penalty.
header.player.choose.path: Choose the Trail you wish to create
tuto.goal: Goal: get the highest score by cleverly filling in your sheet to trace <1>Trails</1>, map <1>Zones</1> and Observe the fauna and flora as you explore.
tuto.dice: Here are the dice. The yellow one goes from 0 to 5, the green one from 1 to 6.
tuto.operator: On your turn, you must choose <0>an Operation</0> to obtain a result.
tuto.choose.op.1: Choose Operation <2/>: the lowest die result.
tuto.operator.exp:
When you choose an Operation, you tick a box in the corresponding line.
<0>If all the boxes in the line are already ticked, you will no longer be able to choose this Operation.</0>
tuto.choose.value.1:
As this is the first round, you can enter your result in whichever circle you want.
Enter your result (1) in this circle.
tuto.obs.exp:
Here are <0>the Observation cards</0>. Each Observation has a corresponding number.
When a player writes down the number corresponding to an Observation, the latter is revealed.
tuto.obs.choose: When an Observation is revealed, its values are reported here, on your data sheet.
tuto.obs.score:
Each time you enter a number, the next value on that Observation line is circled.
At the end of the game, for each Observation <0>you win the points corresponding to the last value circled</0>.
tuto.choose.op.2: This is the second round. This time, choose Operation <2/>: the highest die result.
tuto.pirogue:
The highest die result allows you to cross the River circles safely.
This is indicated by the Canoe symbol on this line.
If you enter a number in a River circle without the Canoe symbol, <0>you will suffer a 5-point penalty at the end of the game.</0>
tuto.choose.value.2: Enter your result (2) in this circle.
tuto.path: <0>Trail</0>: a Trail is a sequence of numbers that follow one another exactly.
tuto.path.exp:
When you enter a number, if it's possible to create or continue a Trail, you must do so.
This line between the 2 and 1 represents the Trail thus created.
tuto.path.score: At the end of the game, each <0>Trail</0> is worth as many points as its highest <0>number, +1 point for each of the other circles</0> that make up the Trail.
tuto.area: <0>Mapped Zone</0>: this is a group of at least 2 adjacent numbers of the same value.
tuto.area.exp:
When you place a number, if it's identical to a neighboring number, it creates or expands a mapped Zone.
The color applied to these 2 circles indicates the Zone.
tuto.area.score: At the end of the game, each mapped <0>Zone</0> is worth as many points as the number in one of its circles, <0>+1 point per other circle</0> in that Zone.
tuto.end.1: The game ends when you've filled in all 20 circles (and thus played 20 times).
tuto.end.2: Warning: at the end of the game, each circle that doesn't belong to either a <0>Trail</0>, or a <0>Zone</0> is called <0>Orphaned</0>, and will entail a penalty of <0>-5 points</0>.
tuto.go: You're on your own now, try and get the highest score possible!
